description:
The complete multi-year record for ONE company: every balance-sheet and P&L
        position's full per-year history, completeness flags and lineage. Read-only. The
        heaviest read - use get_company_details for a normal profile.

        Parameters:
        - company_id (required): "AT:{fnr}" (bare FNR accepted). Austria only today; a German
          id returns a clear error (Germany does not serve a full parsed record yet).

        Returns the AT backend's full-record payload plus ``country`` and the prefixed
        ``company_id``. Includes unknown-code passthrough and the filing years covered.
name: get_full_record
title: Full multi-year record (AT)
